'''T-12N''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] found in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where it managed the requisition of specialty goods.
